location_description: Woodridge is a village in DuPage County, Illinois, with small portions in Will and Cook counties, and a south-western suburb of Chicago. Per the 2020 census, the population was 34,158.The village is just north of the I-55 junction with IL-53. It uses the 630 and 331 area codes.
